experiments.title: Gemini Flash 2.5 Dynamic Model Upgrade
experiments.hypothesis: Transitioning standard invoice parsing from Gemini 1.5 to 2.5 Flash reduces latency by >20% without accuracy loss
experiments.measured_result: P95 latency dropped -25.0% (1.95s -> 1.45s), cost increased +10.0%, accuracy maintained at 99.8%
experiments.impact_summary: Net positive engineering tradeoff: substantial latency reduction with negligible cost impact

experiments.title: Asynchronous Multi-page OCR Deskew Batching
experiments.hypothesis: Parallelizing page pre-processing via ThreadPoolExecutor will increase worker OCR throughput by >15%
experiments.measured_result: OCR processing duration decreased -18.2%, sustained worker DPH increased +20.0%
experiments.impact_summary: High efficiency gain with zero added cloud infrastructure cost

experiments.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Auto-Tuning
experiments.hypothesis: Increasing max server connections from 50 to 100 with PgBouncer transaction pooling eliminates lock wait times
experiments.measured_result: Lock contention events reduced to 0, commit latency dropped -35.0%
experiments.impact_summary: Complete elimination of database connection contention during 5000 DPH load bursts
